donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–314 of 2026 (314 votes, January 6, 2026 to September 16, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
votes.plain_language: The fiscal year 2027 defense bill sets military policy, troop levels, and related Energy Department security programs. votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

votes.plain_language: H.R. 2616 (Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act) requires public elementary and middle schools, as a condition of receiving certain federal funds for elementary and secondary education, to obtain parental consent before changing a student's gender on school forms or changing a student's sex-based accommodations. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act (H R 6472)
votes.bill_title: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires public colleges that participate in federal student aid programs to charge no more than in-state tuition to students who live in Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, or the U.S. Virgin Islands and are U.S. nationals. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — ARTIST Act (S 254)
votes.bill_title: ARTIST Act
votes.plain_language: This bill prohibits states from imposing bans on marine mammal products produced by Alaska Natives. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act (S 723)
votes.bill_title: Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act of 2025
votes.plain_language: This bill sets forth requirements for the processing of a proposed residential leasehold mortgage, business leasehold mortgage, land mortgage, or right-of-way document by the Bureau of Indian Affairs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.bill_title: Calling on elected officials and civil society leaders to counter antisemitism and educate the public on the contributions of the Jewish-American community.
votes.plain_language: This resolution calls on elected officials, faith leaders, and civil society leaders to condemn and counter acts of anti-Semitism. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Save Our Shrimpers Act (H R 2071)
votes.bill_title: Save Our Shrimpers Act
votes.plain_language: This bill prohibits federal funds from being made available to international financial institutions (e.g., the International Monetary Fund) for financing activities related to foreign shrimp farms. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.bill_title: Water Resources Development Act of 2026
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes Army Corps of Engineers water projects, including ports, flood control, and ecosystem work, and it creates an office to speed delivery. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
